title: God Made You
reflectionQuestion: God made every part of you on purpose, with love. What is one thing about you that you think God smiles to see?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime). The LITERAL 'God delights in YOU' -- spoken in second person straight to the child. DOUBLES as comfort for a kid who feels small/unnoticed/not-good-enough: tags feeling_small + self_doubt, mood calm_peaceful is reachable from hurting via expansion, so a 'too little / nobody notices me' kid routes here. 'keeping you safe' was changed to 'loving you' (Adam: no guaranteed-safety promise, see feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause). Ties the not-alone spine ('wherever you go, God is with you', Ps 139:7-10). One image: up past the highest star / down to the deepest sea, God is there.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
